CreateApp.description_en: Creates a new application in a specified workspace
CreateApp.description_zh: 调用此接口在指定空间内创建一个新应用

CreateProduct.description_en: Creates a workspace. A workspace is a group of applications that is used to manage a set of related applications
CreateProduct.description_zh: 创建工作空间。工作空间是应用的分组，用于管理一组相关应用

DeleteApp.description_en: Deletes an application. Deleted applications cannot be recovered. If you delete an application that has been published, normal business operations may be affected. Before deleting, make sure you are aware of this risk
DeleteApp.description_zh: 此接口用于删除应用。应用删除后不可恢复，如果删除已经对外发布的应用，可能会影响正常业务。删除前请确保已知晓此风险

DeleteProduct.description_en: Calls DeleteProduct to delete a workspace

DescribeDashboard.description_en: Retrieves the dashboard information of an application for each service
DescribeDashboard.description_zh: 获取应用在各服务下的看板信息

ListApps.description_en: Queries the list of applications in a specified workspace
ListApps.description_zh: 此ListApps接口用于查询指定工作空间下的应用列表

ListProducts.description_en: Queries a list of workspaces by calling ListProducts
ListProducts.description_zh: 调用ListProducts查询工作空间列表

ModifyApp.description_zh: 此接口用于修改应用信息

ModifyProduct.description_en: Modifies the basic information of a workspace
ModifyProduct.description_zh: 此接口用于修改工作空间基本信息

OpenEmasService.description_en: Activates the Enterprise Mobile Application Studio (EMAS) service. You can use the service only after it is activated
OpenEmasService.description_zh: 开通EMAS服务。只有开通服务后，才能进行产品使用

QueryAppInfo.description_en: Queries the details of an application by calling QueryAppInfo

QueryAppSecurityInfo.description_en: Queries the AppSecret of a specified application. The AppSecret is a secret key used for API request permission verification
QueryAppSecurityInfo.description_zh: 查询指定应用的AppSecret。AppSecret为秘钥信息，用于接口请求权限校验

QueryProductInfo.description_en: Queries the details of a workspace
QueryProductInfo.description_zh: 查询工作空间的详细信息
